scenario: You are working as an usher at a theater. Your manager is explaining what to do before, during, and after the show. Listen to the manager and repeat what the manager says. Repeat only once.

sentences.text: Tonight you'll work as an usher.
The doors open thirty minutes before the show.
Check each ticket and point guests toward their seats.
Late arrivals have to wait until the first scene has ended.
If someone's phone rings during the play, quietly remind them later.
Programs are handed out at the door, and they're free for every guest.
When the play ends, stand by the exits and thank people for coming.
